title: Message/get silently drops non-string IDs instead of invalidArguments
description: message.rs:629-636 uses filter_map(|v| v.as_str()) to extract IDs, silently discarding non-string elements. RFC 8620 §5.1 requires that a malformed IDs array produce invalidArguments. A client sending ["valid-id", 42, null] gets only the first ID with no error, diverging from every other handler in the same file which do return invalidArguments for the same malformed input.
